<action type="say">
I’m not able to actually look up local HVAC companies or book an appointment for you in this environment, so I can’t set up the December 10 visit on your behalf. Nothing has been scheduled, and no changes have been made to any services for your home.

I can, however, make it easy for you to arrange it directly with a local company.

Key details to give any HVAC company
- Address: 456 Oak Street, Ann Arbor, MI 48104  
- System: Gas furnace + central air  
- Purpose: Routine annual preventive maintenance, no current issues  
- Preferred date: December 10  
- Preferred time: choose one: morning or afternoon

What to ask them to include
For a “furnace + AC tune-up” or “annual maintenance,” ask if their visit includes:

Furnace:
- Heat exchanger and burner inspection  
- Combustion safety and CO check  
- Blower motor inspection and lubrication (if applicable)  
- Electrical connections and safety controls check  
- Filter check/replacement (and whether filter is included)

AC (some items may be limited in cold weather, but they should at least inspect):
- Condenser and evaporator coil inspection  
- Refrigerant level check (if conditions permit)  
- Condensate drain inspection/cleaning  
- Thermostat calibration check

General:
- Written report of findings  
- Any parts/labor warranty on work done  
- Total price including all trip/diagnostic/cleaning fees  
- Cancellation/reschedule policy and any fees

Short phone script you can use
“Hi, I’d like to schedule routine annual maintenance for my home HVAC system. I’m at 456 Oak Street in Ann Arbor, 48104. It’s a gas furnace with central air, and there are no current problems — this is just preventive maintenance.

I’m hoping to schedule a combined furnace and AC tune-up on December 10, ideally in the [morning/afternoon].  

Could you tell me:
- Do you service my address?
- What’s the total price for a furnace + AC tune-up, including all fees?
- What’s included in the tune-up?
- Do you have availability on December 10, and what time windows are open?
- What’s your cancellation or reschedule policy?”

If December 10 doesn’t work, ask:  
“If that date isn’t available, what’s the closest date you can do around then?”
